subject: Advanced ops add-ons pricing — retention, tracing, dashboards (proposal & open questions)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@atriahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Advanced ops add-ons pricing — retention, tracing, dashboards (proposal & open questions)

Hi team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I attached a first-pass price breakdown for the observability add-ons (retention buckets, tracing sampling, and the advanced dashboards pack). Highlights:

- Two packaging paths: modular (pick the add-ons you need) vs. consolidated bundle (all three at a tiered discount).
- Example economics for a 12-month committed path vs. month-to-month.
- Suggested guardrails for retention (30/90/365) and trace sampling that map to latency/cost impact.

Open questions for your procurement and infra teams:
1) Do you require seat-based licensing for dashboards or a project-level entitlement?
2) Are there any data residency or retention policies that force us to change the default 365-day archival?
3) Would a two-quarter ramp (50% year 1 commit / 100% year 2) be acceptable for credits and discounting?

I attached the spreadsheet: redwood_addons_price_breakdown_v1.xlsx (xlsx) for the line-by-line numbers.

If useful, Ben can walk through the numbers and Naomi can map the retention SLAs to your compliance asks. Can we schedule a 30-min call early next week to align on packaging preference and any procurement constraints?

Best,

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: redwood_addons_price_breakdown_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Procurement Team <procurement@atriahealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elliot IT <elliot@atriahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Advanced ops add-ons pricing — retention, tracing, dashboards (proposal & open questions)

Laura —

Thanks for sending this over. A few quick clarifications from our side before we loop in finance:
- We prefer project-level entitlements for dashboards (not seat-based) unless there's a compelling operational reason to do seats.
- Data residency: our legal team requires that patient-related telemetry remain within the US and be retained no longer than 365 days. The default is fine, but we need the ability to carve out datasets for shorter retention.
- Ramp: a two-quarter ramp could work; procurement usually asks for a formal SOW and clear commit numbers to approve discounts.

Can Ben or Naomi provide a short note that maps the discount tiers to commit levels and what the SOW would look like? Also, can you confirm whether tracing sampling changes will impact query speed for the dashboards (Elliot asked specifically)?

Thanks,
Procurement Team
procurement@atriahealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@atriahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Advanced ops add-ons pricing — retention, tracing, dashboards (proposal & open questions)

Procurement —

Appreciate the quick turn. Quick answers inline and a proposed concession to accelerate approval:

- Dashboards: we can offer project-level entitlements. Seat-based access will be optional (for advanced sharing controls) but not mandatory.

- Retention: US-only residency for patient telemetry is supported. We can expose retention per dataset and offer a short-retention policy for regulated tables.

- Tracing sampling vs. dashboard speed: reducing sampling rate slightly lowers storage and costs but does not materially change dashboard query latency for the metrics surface. Full traces used for debug sessions will be available on-demand; we suggest an on-demand un-sampled capture for incident windows.

Concession proposal (to move forward quickly):
- 12-month committed bundle (all three add-ons) with a 15% discount off list if you commit to the 12-month spend today and sign the SOW within 21 days.
- If you prefer a ramp, 8% discount for a 6-month commit with the 50% year-1 / 100% year-2 ramp.

I've attached a draft SOW outline (SOW-draft-tria-v1.pdf) for legal to review and a short spreadsheet tab summarizing the discounts.

If that looks reasonable, Laura and I can get a short SOW over and Naomi can include the compliance language.

Best,
Ben Carter
Principal Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
Attachment: sow-tria-advanced-ops-draft.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Elliot IT <elliot@atriahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@atriahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Advanced ops add-ons pricing — retention, tracing, dashboards (proposal & open questions)

Ben / Laura,

Thanks for the clarity. Procurement and I reviewed the concession language. A couple of operational asks before we can commit:

1) Can you add a short runbook to the SOW that outlines the on-demand full-trace capture procedure (who triggers, retention during capture, and access controls)?
2) We need a statement of work appendix that schedules a one-week onboarding window for the dashboards team (kickoff + two training sessions).
3) For billing, can you provide an example invoice for the first three months under the 12-month commitment so our AP team can see the cadence and crediting?

If you can include the three items above in the SOW, Procurement is prepared to move to signature and request a single PO referencing DEAL-3241.

— Elliot
